description: One call returns WHOIS, DNS, and SSL certificate data for any domain. Aggregates RDAP, Cloudflare DNS-over-HTTPS, and Certificate Transparency logs. Covered by Pro subscription, or $0.005 USD per call.

domain.description: Domain name to query, e.g. example.com

include_ssl.description: Fetch SSL certificate history. Defaults to true.

include_whois.description: Fetch WHOIS via RDAP. Defaults to true.

records.description: DNS record types to fetch. Defaults to all seven.

name: domain.intel
